name: huisafe
note: HụiSafe demo film: a voice-led product film with a lo-fi music bed in A# major (85 BPM). Effects stay under the voice: the seal stamp is the one recurring hero sound; coins, taps, clicks and pops are short and quiet; whooshes only on camera moves and scene seams; one reverse swell into the product reveal. Sounds chosen with earshot rank on rendered candidates (stamp knock/wood z +3.39, coin pro_click/tink z +3.30, crack click/snap z +2.65; no bank sound read as breaking pottery, so the jar break is a plain short hit).

tock.note: the seal stamp (S01, S04, S08, the VỠ NỢ tag, the end card): a mid-band wooden knock

hit.note: the jar breaking, and weight under the end-card stamp

snap.note: the crack running down the jar

tick.crisp.note: coins landing in the pot, in wallets, on the phone

tick.note: rounds filling on the status pill, answer lines arriving

land.note: heavier arrivals: the pot, the case headlines

land.light.note: a finger on the phone screen

pop.note: cards, chips, rows and toasts arriving

whoosh.short.note: camera moves, the phone in and out, cards sliding

swell.note: the one reverse swell: into the ivory flood, where the music's beat drops

drop.note: Member 4 comes up short (the red moment), tuned to the music's A#

click.note: the cursor's clicks on the laptop

key.note: typing into the form and the bid field

bell.note: good outcomes: coverage reaches 100%, the payouts land, zero left in the contract

text.note: paper: the envelope flap folding, the struck job card

off.suck: not used: the seams are camera moves, not cuts
off.riser: not used: the music's own build carries the reveal
off.key.space: no space bar in the typing
